## Summary
check-story-handoff.sh reads the predecessor story's verifier JSON verdict and halts sprint Phase E dispatch if verdict != PASS. This is a machine check on a structured field, not an LLM assertion.

## Done Definitions
- check-story-handoff.sh reads predecessor verifier JSON verdict field
- Halts if field != PASS with structured error output
- Sprint Phase E dispatch blocked when predecessor verdict != PASS
- Integration test: FAIL verdict blocks successor dispatch; PASS permits it

## SC Coverage
SC2

## Depends On
S1 (typed-enum verifier schema must be available)

## Escalation Policy
Escalate when blocked
